583030000039.source_citation: Fair Haven Methodist Church. Otto Woestemeyer designed a church campus master plan beginning c. 1956. Bishop Frank A. Smith laid the cornerstone for the first unit in October 1956. By 1959, 3 of 5 units had been completed. The sanctuary completed in 1967 does not match Woestemeyer's 1950s design, and the architect for the 1967 building is not listed. At least one of Woestemeyer's 1950s units is extant. Sources: Houston Post; Houston Chronicle; historicaerials.com
